s.threeVs17Attribution: DOMINANT SOURCE OF THE ~14 EXCESS = CO-RESIDENCY (the batch M-shape), NOT either of cat9's two extra kernels. Decisive banked existence test: chain5 = cat9's EXACT two kernels (forked-FA2 tree-bias + GDN tree-scan) running the 5-spine ALONE with NO branches (M=spine) → de-cascades to 2 independent clear-margin flips, AT-OR-BELOW native's 3 (FR13_PLUS2_DECASCADE, MEASURED, same de-cascade rule all arms). So the kernels by themselves spine at the E5 floor. cat9 adds 4 branch rows into the SAME batched forward (M=spine+branches) → spine drifts ~17. Mechanism pinned: commit 2fe2c567 = 11/11 channel-2 clear-margin flips land ON THE SPINE, 0 on the leaves = SPINE_PERTURBATION. Per-kernel: (a) forked-FA2 vs FLASH = NOT the source — CODE-READ (fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py L40-78): it is the SAME FA2 CUTLASS kernel, only adds a dense ancestry bias to acc_s post-QK/pre-mask; for an ancestor (q,k) the added value is 0.0, so exp2 softmax/fp32 accum/online-rescale/qk-cast/MMA are byte-identical to native FLASH on the spine — there is NO divergent op to align. MEASURED: 2 single-bf16-ULP in ~983k, no depth growth; QPAD null (L31 carrier 3.9e-3→0.0 yet e2e flips unchanged) = downstream amplifier not originator. (b) GDN tree-scan vs native MTP-5 scan = the per-LAYER FLOOR origin (fp32-compute/bf16-STORE recurrent) but NEAR-bit-exact: scan_out 1e-6, state rel-err 2.2e-4 (K1) — by itself spines at the floor (chain5), so not the ~14 source. (c) Compounding: same per-layer floor as E5 but cat9's L0 birth-amplitude is bigger and it runs MORE divergent spine forwards (co-resident), riding the same geometric amplification. The ~14 = co-residency M-dependence (class #10 codegen identity / #11 batch-composition), an alignable realization not intrinsic tree math.
s.whereDiffuse: MEASURED from node5 per_layer_maxabs.json (input byte-exact 0.0, apples-to-apples). (a) BORN in GDN-layer COMPUTE at L0: first-nonzero L0 linear_attention ~2 bf16-ULP from 0.0 input (node5/node7); one-layer trace = conv1d_out 0.000977 (1-ULP anchor row) + gdn_scan_out 1e-6 (bf16-store recurrent), in_proj/o_proj fp8 ~0 (M-invariant). (b) AMPLIFIED in the inter-layer RESIDUAL-STREAM CONNECTION, signal-proportionally — DECOMPOSED the 1.166x/layer geomean BY LAYER TYPE: GDN layers amplify geomean 1.075x/layer (median 1.053, max 1.289, n=45); FULL-ATTN layers amplify geomean 1.236x/layer (median 1.212, max 1.615, n=15). The 4-5 largest single jumps are ALL full-attn (L35 1.61x, L51 1.34x, L47 1.32x). hid_L2 (layer-output diff) tracks resid_L2 (residual-stream) at a ~constant ratio → the amplification is a CONNECTION effect (residual carrying a proportional perturbation forward + next layer's input-norm/QKV reading the drifted residual), NOT a fresh additive per-layer ULP, and dominated by the deep full-attn connections (1.24x vs GDN 1.08x). The 'gate 1/rms amplifies 32x' claim is REFUTED: gate is fp32 (CODE-READ layernorm.py L455-503) and measured GDN-layer ratios are 1.0-1.29x, never 32x. (c) Crystallizes L60/L61 (sustained final-token flip) as a one-token logit collapse (` ``` ` 26.60→15.94, ~10.7 nat) crossing a small 1.875-nat boundary margin.

Align the M=10 spine-row computation to the M=5/M=1 one, op-by-op. Two named seams: (1) forked-FA2 query-tile M-dependence (CODE-READ: apply_tree_bias row offset m_block*kBlockM+(tidx/32)*16+(tidx%32)/4 is M-dependent; QPAD fixed-tile direction, but its e2e-null says fix this AFTER the GDN seam); (2) GDN deep-accept state-feed at num_accepted>1 = the FIRST-nonzero L0-GDN co-residency carrier (prime suspect conv1d prior-window / state-bank column geometry, 'fixable wiring at fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:797-818', project_fr13_conv_priorwindow_root) = highest-value alignment. The alignment target is OUR OWN M=5 spine (chain5), not native (native has no tree-scan).
